brief: Select an original callback identity from a record identifier.
notes: Original instructions establish controller ordering; callback bodies remain external implementations.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete callback-identity selector. This returns original 32-bit identities and never invokes or reconstructs the handlers.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: All uint32 record identifiers; original jump-table groups and out-of-range defaults are compared.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 38 original/native cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang; connected lifecycle traces also match. See docs/recovery/record-transitions.md.
